writeup: GoSports Splash Pass PRO is a giant floating pool football game with a 42-inch target, four footballs, four baseballs, a pump and sand bag. Woot has it new for $59.99 with only three left and a three-per-customer limit. GoSports sells the same blue kit for $129.99 and Pool Guy Supply lists it at $169.99, so this clears well over the forty-percent new bar for a summer stash buy.
